Dwarf

Stone, craft, stubborn loyalty and a memory for debts both kind and cruel.

Rules

Choose two of the five traits below. These are invitations to a familiar fantasy, not a required personality. Any ancestry may grow up in any culture.

Starting values: HP +4; base Speed 5.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.90de291d03b1a841.JournalEntryPage.98941c8f591a35c8]{Stubborn as Bedrock} — Your ancestors did not dig a home from the mountain by yielding politely. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.533a9b640cc24ef0.JournalEntryPage.c9e99d0eee8886be]{The Mountain Remembers} — You know a mason’s lie by the stone around it. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.e2213d13a5e3457c.JournalEntryPage.4c8a691af33f941c]{Rooted in Stone} — Let the storm waste its strength on you. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.6885c62767a638fa.JournalEntryPage.b27b61f1605cdbc9]{An Honest Maker’s Hand} — Your thumb finds the seam; your ear knows the ring of sound metal. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.30c0dc2f9ccfd83e.JournalEntryPage.5fd2f2804da92cc3]{A Grudge Well Kept} — You remember who struck first. You intend them to remember what followed.

Starting coin contribution: +2 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
